scientific_integrity: The rate and entropy gaps are derived exactly. A standard-library numerical checker supplements, but does not replace, the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The counterexample concerns one explicit full-support distribution and the specified slope-maximizing coarsening rule.
No worst-case approximation ratio or classification of all greedy trajectories is claimed.
Literature search does not eliminate the possibility of an unindexed or unpublished equivalent example.
title: A minimal strict-domination witness for greedy zero-error side-information coarsening
